title: Every month you wait, the middleman keeps his cut.
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). Modern boutique-hotel world: walnut wood, cream plaster, greenery, contemporary fixtures. NO dated props, no cash. Elegant, quiet, expensive. 4:5 (1080x1350). No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Path B — scene/organic. Cost-of-delay. s5 is a frameless composite — clean editorial scene with UI screenshot overlaid freely. Claims audited: no figure is asserted about the reader's business and no delivery timeline is promised; s2 asks the reader to compute their own number instead.

slides.headline:
==$4,650== a year.
Per room. To the middleman.
slides.sub: That's 15% on an $85/night average. Every month you wait, that number grows.
slides.imagePrompt: A boutique-hotel owner late in the evening reviewing numbers by warm lamp light at a modern walnut desk, pensive, a laptop glowing softly (screen not readable), plant nearby, deep navy shadows (face soft / not identifiable). LEAVE THE TOP THIRD a calm darker wall for the headline; subject lower. CRITICAL: any darker area must be darker ONLY because the scene's own light falls off naturally — NOT because a dark band, gradient, vignette or overlay has been applied. There must be NO horizontal boundary, step, line or abrupt change of tone anywhere in the frame; brightness must fall away gradually and continuously. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]

slides.title: ==Run your own number.==
slides.body: Nights sold through OTAs last month, times your average rate, times your commission rate. That figure repeats every month nothing changes.

slides.headline: ==Stop the meter.==
slides.sub: Two ways to start booking direct — a widget on your current site, or a full build.
slides.imagePrompt: A pale oak dining table in a bright boutique apartment kitchen and dining area, morning light from a large window, a coffee cup and a small plant to one side, cream plaster and warm wood behind. Generous open space for UI overlay. NO DEVICE, NO LAPTOP, NO PHONE, NO SCREEN — just the pure scene. Compose the subject in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame.
